verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents two scripting interfaces. A Python package controls and extends the terminal [docs-13, gh-15], and AppleScript support can launch the app and open sessions with profiles in new tabs or windows [docs-14, docs-33]. A community user corroborates that the Python API 'lets you touch pretty much everything' [comm-5]. missing for 10: explicit evidence for sending text to sessions and querying session/window state, and a dedicated standalone CLI (control goes through Python/AppleScript rather than a first-class command-line tool).
